description.value: The Hampton Inn by Hilton Vancouver-Airport/Richmond is a full-service airport hotel located in Richmond, BC, convenient to Vancouver International Airport and positioned along the Vancouver Crossing Loop cycling route. As part of the Hampton Inn brand, it offers consistent mid-scale hotel amenities in a suburban setting near the airport's southern approach. Touring cyclists finishing or starting near YVR will find it a practical overnight option with easy access to the flat cycling infrastructure of Richmond.

address.value: 8811 Bridgeport Rd, Richmond, BC V6X 1R9, Canada
